description.default: Unified cards for external MCP tool calls: argument summaries, tables, content blocks and error states, covering 24 search and developer services such as Anysearch, DBX, Firecrawl and Chrome DevTools. Requires a compatible desktop host.
description.zh-CN: 为外部 MCP 工具调用提供统一卡片：参数摘要、表格、内容块与错误状态，覆盖 Anysearch、DBX、Firecrawl、Chrome DevTools 等 24 类搜索与开发服务。需配套支持工具卡插槽的桌面宿主。
description.zh-TW: 為外部 MCP 工具呼叫提供統一卡片：參數摘要、表格、內容區塊與錯誤狀態，覆蓋 Anysearch、DBX、Firecrawl、Chrome DevTools 等 24 類搜尋與開發服務。需配套支援工具卡插槽的桌面宿主。
description.en: Unified cards for external MCP tool calls: argument summaries, tables, content blocks and error states, covering 24 search and developer services such as Anysearch, DBX, Firecrawl and Chrome DevTools. Requires a compatible desktop host.
